tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// ring bsrel lnga'i gzhug tshul lag len tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so//ring bsrel lnga'i gzhug tshul lag len tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho zhes bya ba// bla ma dang mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// tshogs gnyis chu gter 'jings las legs 'khrungs mtshams sprin gzhon nus 'khyud pa'i sku// sna tshogs 'od kyi lding khang 'dzin cing mtshan dpe'i mdzes rgyan kun nas 'chang*// shes rab ut+pal ltar sngo'i mtshon gyis mi shes dra ba rtsad nas gcod// stong phrag brgya pa'i glegs bam 'dzin mdzad 'jam mgon bla mas bdag skyongs shig /'dir gang brjod par bya ba'i dngos ni bde bar gshegs pa'i sku dang thugs kyi rten dag gi nang du ring bsrel lnga ji ltar gzhug pa nyid yin no// de la'ang rten tshad dang ldan pa dgos tshul/ tshad med kyi nyes pa skyed pa dag go// dang po tshad kyi rnam par bzhag pa'ang gsung rab rin po che rnams su mang du gsungs kyang 'dir yongs su grags pa la// rgyal ba'i sku gzugs kyi tshad ni gnyis te/ sprul sku dang*/ longs sku'o// ༈ /dang po ni/ dus kyi 'khor lo las/ rgyal ba'i bdag po'i gtsug tor nas ni mdzod spu'i dbus su phyed dang bcas pa'i nyi ma'i sor du 'gyur// zhes pa nas/ mdzod spu gsang ba'i chu skyes dbus su khu ba'i thig le mi 'gyur bde ba skyed byed gnas pa gang*// zhes pa'i bar gyis/ sor mo brgya dang nyer lnga'i nges pa gsungs la/ sdom pa 'byung bar/ zhal ni bcu gnyis cha yin no sogs gsungs pa ni sor mo brgya dang nyi shu par bzhed pa'o// ༈ */gnyis pa longs sku la'ang*/ ji skad du/ zab mo rdo rje can gyi lha/ cha ni bcu gnyis tshad yin no/ /zhes sogs kyis nges pa snga ma ltar ro// 'khor los sgyur ba'i cha lugs can gyi longs sku rnams kyang sangs rgyas ji lta ba nyid do/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni bslab btus las/

byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyang sor bcu gnyis pa'i thal mo bcu pa nyid do/ /zhes so// khro bo rnams ni/ sdom pa las/ khro bo khro mo dbang phyug ma// zhes pa nas/ thal mo bcu par rnam par bri// zhes pa'i bar ro/ /gshin rje'i gshed sogs ni/ gshin rje'i gshed nag po'i rgyud las/ khro bo sbom la thung bar bshad// ces pa nas| |rin chen cod pan sor drug gi// zhes pa'i bar gyis mtho brgyad par gsungs so// gzhan yang sdom 'byung 'grel par/ thag bzang ris sogs kyang mtho brgyad par gsungs shing*/ tshogs bdag la sogs pa ni sa muts+tshar mtho lnga par gsungs so/ /nyan rang sogs mi rnams ni/ dus kyi 'khor lo las/ de nyid sems can rnams kyi khru bzhi pa ste mi rnams kyi sor mo dgu bcu rtsa drug go// zhes sogs gsungs la/ bla ma'i sku rnams kyang tshad 'di'i khongs su bsdu'o| |'on kyang bla ma'i sku'ang blun po'i blo 'dod kyi mthong nyams dang rmi lam sogs la snyad pa'i sku mdog phyag mtshan bzhugs tshul sogs spre'u dang*/ khyi rgan dang*/ sha za lta bu'i gya ma do mi bya bar mtshan dpe'i rnam par rjes mthun pa nyid bya ba ni/ mgon po 'bri gung pas/ lha thams cad mtshan dpe'i yon tan dang ldan par bshad pa ltar nges pa'o// ༈ /thugs rten gyi tshad kyang dri ma med pa'i mdo'i dgongs pa dpyis phyin pa bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa dang*/ brag nag pa dpal ldan legs dbang dang dpal sgang lo tsā ba sogs mkhyen pa'i spyan ldan rnams kyis bkral ba cha chen bcu drug po bzhi bzhir phye bas cha phran drug cu rtsa bzhi pa nyid tshad mar gzung gi/ de las gzhan pa'i rang 'dod kyi rdzun rib legs bshad du rlom pa rnams ni chu shing ltar snying po med do// tshad ldan las gzhan pa'i tshad med kyi rten la rab gnas mi chags pa'ang*/ rab tu gnas pa'i rgyud las/ tshad kyis tshad la phab cing bzang*// zhes sogs gsungs so// gnyis pa tshad med kyis nyes pa skyed pa ni/

sdom pa 'byung bar/ kos ko mgrin pa byin pa ste/ /gsum po ring na skyon chen po// zhes pa nas| mkhas pas legs par brtag par bya// zhes pa'i bar/ nyes pa dpag tu med par gsungs so// de ltar tshad dang ldan pa'i rten bris 'bur gang la'ang ring bsrel lnga sogs tshad ldan du bzhugs pa dag la ni ji ltar chung yang bsod nams kyi dngos po gzhal du med par gsungs la/ mngon pa'i nga rgyal can dag gis khe grags don du gnyer bas/ rten rgyu dang tshad sogs skye bos mngon sum du gyur pa rnams rgya dpangs che che ltar bgyis nas ring bsrel gyi tshogs rnams lkog gyur du bsams nas gang byung des chog gis sla chos byas pa rnams la ni phan yon lta zhog nyes pa'i rgyur 'gyur ba kho na yin te/ ji skad du/ khang bu brtsegs pa'i mdo las/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan bstan pa'i phyir kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo khyod kyis 'dzam bu'i gling gi gling mthong ngam/ kye btsun pa mthong lags so// kun dga' bo 'dzam bu'i gling gi gling ni zheng du dpag tshad bdun stong*/ mchur yang dpag tshad bdun stong ste/ byang gi zheng ni che/ lho'i zheng ni shing rta'i dbyibs so// de rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo dad pa can la las rin po che sna bdun gyis bkang ste/ rgyun du zhugs pa rnams dang*/ lan gcig phyir 'ong ba rnams dang*/ phyir mi 'ong ba rnams dang*/ dgra bcom pa rnams dang*/ rang sangs rgyas rnams dang*/ phyogs bzhi'i dge slong gi dge 'dun la 'bul bar byed pa dang*/ gang zhig de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i mchod rten 'jim pa las skyu ru ra tsam byed du 'jug /srog shing khab tsam 'dzugs su 'jug /gdugs ni rgya shug gi lo ma tsam 'gebs su 'jug cing*/ sku gzugs nas 'bru tsam byed du 'jug la/

sku gdung yungs kar gyi 'bru tsam 'jug par byed na/ kun dga' bo 'di nyid de bas bsod nams shin tu mang bar nga smra'o// kun dga' bo 'dzam bu'i gling gi gling lta yang zhog gi/ kun dga' bo shar gyi lus 'phags zhes bya ba'i gling zheng du'ang dpag tshad brgyad stong*// mchur yang dpag tshad brgyad stong kun nas zla ba kham pa lta bu zhig yod de// de rigs kyi bu'am sogs nas/ nga smra'o zhes pa'i bar sbyar/ kun dga' bo 'dzam bu'i gling gi gling lta yang zhog /shar gyi lus 'phags kyi gling lta yang zhog gi/ kun dga' bo nub kyi ba lang spyod ces bya ba'i gling zheng du dpag tshad dgu stong*/ mchur yang dpag tshad dgu stong pa kun nas zla ba nya ba lta bu zhig yod de/ de rigs kyi bu'am nas nga smra'o/ kun dga' bo 'dzam bu'i gling gi gling lta yang zhog /shar gyi lus 'phags chen po'i gling lta yang zhog /nub kyi ba lang spyod kyi gling lta yang zhog gi/ kun dga' bo byang gi sgra mi snyan zhes bya ba'i gling zheng du dpag tshad khri/ mchur yang dpag tshad khri pa kun nas gru bzhi pa zhig yod de/ de rigs kyi bu'am nas nga smra'o// kun dga' bo 'dzam bu'i gling gi gling lta yang zhog /shar gyi lus 'phags kyi gling lta yang zhog /nub kyi ba lang spyod kyi gling lta yang zhog /byang gi sgra mi snyan gyi gling lta yang zhog gi/ kun dga' po lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyi khang bzang rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba yod de/ de rigs kyi bu'am nas nga smra'o/ kun dga' bo 'dzam bu'i gling gi gling lta yang zhog /shar gyi lus 'phags kyi gling lta yang zhog /nub kyi ba lang spyod kyi gling lta yang zhog /byang gi sgra mi snyan gyi gling lta yang zhog /lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyi khang bzang rnam par rgyal ba lta yang zhog gi/ kun dga' bo stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams yod de/

de rigs kyi bu'am nas nga smra'o// de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kun dga' bo 'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni sbyin pa dpag tu med pa/ tshul khrims dpag tu med pa/ bzod pa dpag tu med pa/ brtson 'grus dpag tu med pa/ bsam gtan dpag tu med pa/ shes rab dpag tu med pa/ byams pa dang btang snyoms kyi bar dpag tu med de/ kun dga' bo de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni yon tan dpag tu med pa dang ldan pa'i phyir/ zhes rgya cher gsungs la/ gzhan yang rten 'brel snying po'i mdo dang*/ shes pas thams cad mthar phyin par 'grub pa'i mchod rten zhes bya ba'i gzungs la sogs pa dpag tu med pa nas kyang rten gyi rgyu dang rgya dpangs bas/ nang du ring bsrel gyi tshogs bzhugs pa kho na gal che bar gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ ༈ /de ltar phan yon rnam pa du ma dang ldan pa'i ring bsrel gyi tshogs gzhug tshul la'ang*/ ring bsrel lnga ni/ chos kyi sku'i ring bsrel/ yungs 'bru lta bu'i ring bsrel/ chos kyi ring bsrel/ sku gdung gi ring bsrel/ sku bal gyi ring bsrel rnams so/ ༈ /de dag gi chos kyi sku'i ring bsrel ni/ rnam pa brdar btags pa'i chos sku'i rten bde bar gshegs pa'i mchod rten brgyad dang sāts+tsha lta bu yin la/ nang du bzhugs pa'i chos sku'i ring bsrel ni/ oṃnamobhagawateshākyamunāye/ tathāgatāya.ar+hatesamyak+saṃbud+dhāya/ tad+yathā/ oṃmunimunimahāmunayeswāhā/ zhes dang*/ gzhan yang gtsug tor rnam rgyal/ gtsug tor dri med/ gsang ba ring bsrel/ byang chub snying po'i rgyan 'bum/ rten 'brel snying po rnams yin no/ ༈ /yungs 'bru lta bu'i ring bsrel ni/ 'phags pa gsum sogs gang zag khyad par can gyi gdung las byung ba ste/ de yang kha dog dwangs shing sran ma'i rdog po tsam yan chad la gdung zhes dang*/ de bas chung ba rnams la ring bsrel zhes bya la|

gsang sngags rnying ma'i sku gdung 'bar ba'i rgyud sogs la ni/ sha rī ram/ ba ri ram/ chu ri ram/ nya ri ram/ pañtsa ram/ zhes lngar dbye ba'ang kha dog gi dbye ba tsam du zad pa'i phyir/ de ltar gdung dang ring bsrel thams cad yungs 'bru lta bu'i ring bsrel gyi khongs su bsdu'o/ ༈ /chos kyi ring bsrel ni/ gsang chen rdo rje theg pa mchog nas gsungs pa'i sngags rnams dang*/ mtshan nyid pha rol tu phyin pa mdo sde'i theg pa nas gsungs pa'i gzungs kyi tshogs ji snyed pa dang*/ gzhan yang rgyal ba'i bka' dang de dag gi dgongs 'grel tshad mar gyur pa rnams chos kyi ring bsrel zhes bya'o/ ༈ /sku gdung gi ring bsrel ni/ rtsa ba'i bla ma sogs gang zag mchog sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' nyan rang gi tshogs dang bcas pa'i sku gdung ngam/ de las byung ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten nam/ de dag gi cha shas sha khrag rus pa'i tshogs la sogs pa rnams ni sku gdung gi ring bsrel zhes bya'o| ༈ /sku bal gyi ring bsrel ni/ bshad ma thag pa'i gang zag de rnams kyi dbu skra dang*/ phyag zhabs kyi sen mo dang*/ na bza' la sogs pa mdor na sku dang 'brel ba'i byin rlabs kyi tshogs ji snyed pa la sku bal gyi ring bsrel zhes bshad do/ ༈ /da ni sku dang thugs kyi rten gang la'ang ring bsrel lnga gzhug pa'i tshul la gnyis/ nyer bsdogs bya ba dang*/ 'jug tshul dngos so// dang po nyer bsdogs bya ba ni/ rdo rje 'chang nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar gyi mtshan 'bum rnams dang*/ gzhan yang paṇ+ḍi ta rnams dang grub thob chen po rnams dang*/ lo tsā ba chen po rnams dang*/ gzhan yang mdo sngags dbang bskur khrid lung man ngag dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi mtshan 'bum/ gser dngul la sogs brtan g.yo zhu ba dang mi zhu ba'i khams las grub pa'i rin po che rnams kyi khu ba/ dri bzang po'i chu dang sbyar bas rab lañtsa dang wartu'i rnam pa/

de ma byung yang yi ge dbu can nyid du bris te/ de dag kyang mtshan re re yi ge 'bru gsum gyi bar du bcug pa 'dod gsol dang bcas pa legs par sbyar ba saṃskṛta'i skad du 'bri ste/ rdo rje 'chang lta bu la/ oṃ.āḥgurubadz+radhṛkamahāmudrasid+dhiphalahūm̐/ zhes pa lta bu dang*/ de bzhin du mtshan dang sbyar ba'ang legs sbyar mi shes na/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen po la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ zhes pa lta bu 'bri'o// de nas 'bri ba'i rgyu snga ma kho na lta bus rang gi yi dam lhag pa'i lha gang yin gyi phreng sngags rtsa sngags snying po nye snying sa bon la sogs pa rnams dang*/ gzhan yang gtsug tor rnam rgyal/ dri med/ gsang ba ring bsrel/ byang chub rgyan 'bum/ rten 'brel snying po/ dus kyi 'khor lo nas bzung bya rgyud yan gyi rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i sngags ji snyed pa dang*/ mdo sde rnams nas gsungs pa'i gzungs kyi tshogs rnams dang*/ dam pa ye shes chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams kyi sngags dang*/ dpal mgon bdun cu gnod sbyin nor lha'i tshogs dang bcas pa ji snyed pa'i sngags rnams legs par bris nas chad lhag la sogs pa brtags shing dpyad nas shin tu dag par bgyis pa dang*/ rten chen po gzungs kyis mi gang ba yod na/ rgyud dang mdo sde bka' bstan bcos yang dag pa'i glegs bam rnams kyang tshang zhing mi 'khrugs pa zhus dag legs par bgyis pa la sogs pa rnams so/ ༈ /gzhan yang bla ma dag gi gdung rus la sogs pa gzhug na'ang de dag zhib tu brdungs pa/ 'jim pa dri bzang po dang bcas pas sā'ats+tsha btab cing sāts+tsha re re'i nang du'ang srog shing rten 'brel snying po can rtse mor gdugs dang bcas pa grangs rten gyi nang du+u shong tshod du bya/ de rnams la dkar rtsi gsol/ ༈ /gshin po phal pa'i don yin na rus chog byas la sāts+tsha snga ma ltar btab pa kho na sgrib pa'i gnyen por 'gyur zhing*/

gshin po'i rus bu cung zad gzungs 'bri ba'i snag tshar bsres na sgrib sbyong gi gnyen po dpyis phyin par 'gyur ro/ ༈ /gzhan yang bla ma'i dgongs rdzogs nang rten lta bu la gdung ril por bzhag pa'ang blun dad ma gtogs cung zad mi legs la/ de bzhin du gdung rus yin na'ang sāts+tsha byas pa nyid legs kyi/ gdung rus kho na 'jug pa ni don la mi gnas shing*/ gshin po phal pa'i rus bu dngos su bcug na gshin po de la shin tu gnod par gsungs la/ 'ga' zhig gis gshin don yin na de'i rus bu rten gyi zhabs dgag gi 'og zangs zhabs kyi nang du 'jug par 'dod pa ni gshin po la de shin tu gnod pa'i las yin pas rnam par 'khyams so/ ༈ /gzhan yang bla ma rnams kyi sku bal gyi ring bsrel rnams kyang rang nyid dad pa dang zhen pa rgyu mtshan du byas nas/ bla ma phan tshun thugs mi mthun pa gnyis kyi gdung dang sku bal la sogs rten gcig tu bcug na rten de sel gyi phung por 'gyur bar gsungs pas/ de 'dra ba dag la gcig bcug cing gcig mi gzhug pa kho na nyid legs la/ brgyud pa'i rim pa yang dam nyams dang 'dres khyer sogs ma dag pa'i dpyad gzhi gleng slong yod pa rnams mi gzhug go// gzhan yang bla ma'i na bza' sogs kyang dar gos ras sogs la byas pa gzhug gi/ bal la byas pa ni ring por lon nas rang bzhin gyi srin bu brdzus te skyes nas gzungs gzhug gzhan rnams la'ang gnod pa byed pa'i phyir mi gzhug go// bla ma'i phya'u'i dum bu tsam ma gtogs dngos tshang ba mi gzhug ste/ bka' gdams kyi bstan pa dar la yun thung ba ni bla mar mos gus kyi dbang gis phya'u mang po rten gyi nang du bcug pas nyes so zhes pa'ang gleng bas so/ ༈ /de ltar ring bsrel lnga po legs par tshogs nas dri bzang po'i chus byug cing*/ gzungs rnams dril lugs gang ltar byas kyang rung ste 'khor lo lta bu 'khor bas las bsgrub dgos na gnad shin tu che yang*/

'dir nang gzhug tsam yin pa'i phyir mgo sgril mjug sgril dang sngags phyi nang du dril yang rung la/ 'on kyang lag len sngags yig zhal nang du bstan/ dril lugs mgo nas sgril na rtsa rig sbrul 'khyil ba lta bu zhes pa rig pas grub la/ mjug nas sgril yang thog mar zhal phye na dbu sngon la 'ong ba'i phyir klog pa'i rig pas grub pas de gnyis gang bde byar rung ngo*// gang ltar byed kyang shin tu dam par bsgril/ sngar las ma song ba'i za 'og la sogs pa'i srad bus 'ja' tshon ltar dkri/ dbu ngos su zhal byang dang bcas pa gzungs rnams so sor dril ba bzhag /gsung rab rnams glegs shing dang glegs thag dor nas dar ras gtsang ma'i na bza' dang dri bzang gi phur ma dang bcas pa legs par ma 'chol bar tshon skud kyis dkri/ 'on kyang gsung rab bzhugs pa rnams glegs bam gyi rnam pa lta bu ma gtogs gzungs ltar sgril mi dgos/ gzhan pa'i gdung dang ring bsrel gyi tshogs rnams kyang so so'i rigs mthun bsdoms par dri bzang dang bcas pa na bza' gsar pas dril nas ca ga thon par bya'o// nang gzhug gi gzungs rnams dril zin nas rab gnas rgyas pa zhig grub na legs shing*/ rgyas pa ma grub kyang bsdus pa zhig cis kyang bya/ gzhan sku gsung thugs rten nang gzhug tu gzhug rgyu rnams la'ang rab gnas bsdus pa tsam bskyar ba shin tu gal che'o// de nas gnod sbyin yab yum gyi 'khor lo ni/ rten chen po rnams la pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi dbus dang phyogs mtshams rnams su gnod sbyin yab yum rin po che las byas pa'i bris 'bur gang 'dod kyi gzugs so so'i snying khar sngags tshig bris nas gnas ma 'chol bar 'god pa dang*/ 'ga' zhig pad+ma 'dab brgyad gnyis kyi nang du lha'i gzugs bris pa'i snying khar sngags tshig 'bri ba dang*/ gzhan yang 'khor lo la brten kyang yum steng du byed pa dang*/ yab yum gyi sngags mgo rten gyi mdun du ston pa dang*/

phyogs mtshams kyi sngags dbu rub tu byed pa sogs lag len mi 'dra ba mang dag cig mchis pa dang*/ yang phyogs mtshams kyi sngags rnams phyogs g.yas skor nyid du bris pas zhal sbyar tshe yab yum gnas 'chol na shin tu nongs par 'gyur ba dang*/ gzhan yang 'khor lo 'bri ba 'phyug na nyes pa bskyed pa dpag tu med de/ deng sang blun po grags pa'i rjes su 'brangs pas rten bzhengs nas gnod sbyin 'khor lo sogs gdan rnams rang gis mi shes bzhin du shes par rlom zhing*/ mkhas pa gzhan la bcol na khe grags nyams kyi dogs pa dang*/ rang gis mi shes pa'i 'tshang de gsal por mthong gi dogs nas mi shes bzhin du nan gyis 'bad pas bdag gzhan gnyis phung 'di phyi thams cad sdug bsngal la sbyor ba rnams lta zhog /gnod sbyin 'khor lo 'bri ba'i gnad ma 'phyug kyang gzhug tshul mtho dman kha phyogs tsam nor bas kyang yon bdag la nyes pa sna tshogs 'byung ba rang res kyang lan 'ga' yar gzhan gyis de ltar byas pa mngon sum gyi gnas su mthong ba'i phyir/ thog mar lag len rnam par dag pas bri ba'i rim pa ni/ dar gos sam ras ser po'am shog bu dri ma bug rdol med pa la/ gza' skar bzang zhing shis pa'i nyin 'khor lo mu khyud bzhi pa/ gnyis bskor ba'i mu khyud dang po gnyis lte ba dang mnyam pa'i 'dab brgyad mnyam gsum can du bris/ yum 'khor gyi lte bar/ oṃ bkra shis bāsudhariṇ+yaimamadhanaṃdehidehiswāhā/ nor 'dzin ma bdag la nor stsol cig stsol cig gzhi tshug /de bzhin du mam nas swāhā'i bar yab yum thams cad la sbyar te/ mdun nas brtsams sngags mgo phyir bstan chos skor du/ shar gyi 'dab mar/ oṃtsan+d+rakān+tāyaimamadhanaṃdehidehiswāhā/ zla ba chu sher ma bdag la nor stsol cig stsol cig gzhi tshug /lhor/ oṃdat+tāyaimamadhanaṃdehidehiswāhā/ byin ma bdag la nor stsol cig stsol cig gzhi tshug

/nub tu/ oṃsudat+tāyaimamadhanaṃdehidehiswāhā/ rab byin ma'am bzang byin ma bdag la nor stsol cig stsol cig gzhi tshug /byang du/ oṃ.ār+yāyaimamadhanaṃdehidehiswāhā/ 'phags ma bdag la nor stsol cig stsol cig gzhi tshug /shar lhor/ oṃsubhadriyaimamadhanaṃdehidehiswāhā/ shin tu bzang mo bdag la nor stsol cig stsol cig gzhi tshug /lho nub tu/ o+oṃgup+tāyaimamadhanaṃdehidehiswāhā/ sbas ma bdag la nor stsol cig stsol cig gzhi tshug /nub byang du/ oṃdebyaimamadhanaṃdehidehiswāhā/ lha mo bdag la nor stsol cig stsol cig gzhi tshug /byang shar du/ oṃswaraswat+yaimamadhanaṃdehidehiswāhā/ dbyangs can ma bdag la nor stsol cig stsol cig gzhi tshug /yang na/ mam nas de hi'i bar gyi 'dod gsol gyi tshab tu/ sarbalak+ṣebhūtisam+padodehimisarbasatwanañtsa/ zhes pa swā hā rnams kyi gong du bcug kyang nyan no// yab 'khor gyi lte bar/ oṃdzaṃbhaladzalen+d+rayamamadhanaṃdehidehiswāhā/ gnod gnas sam rmugs 'dzin chu'i dbang po bdag la nor stsol cig stsol cig gzhi tshug /mdun shar du/ oṃmaṇibhadrāyamamadhanaṃdehidehiswāhā/ nor bu bzang po bdag la nor stsol cig stsol cig gzhi tshug /bon skor du lhor/ oṃpūr+ṇabhadrāyamamadhanaṃdehidehiswāhā/ gang ba bzang po bdag la nor stsol cig stsol cig gzhi tshug /nub tu| oṃdhanadāyamamadhanaṃdehidehiswāhā/ nor sbyin bdag la nor stsol cig stsol cig gzhi tshug /byang du*/ oṃbaishramaṇayemamadhanaṃdehidehiswāhā/ rnam thos sras bdag la nor stsol cig stsol cig gzhi tshug /shar lhor/ oṃkilimālinemamadhanaṃdehidehiswāhā/ rol pa'i phreng ba bdag la nor stsol cig stsol cig gzhi tshug /lho nub tu/ oṃpitsikuṇ+ḍalinimamadhanaṃdehidehiswāhā/ 'jam po 'khyil pa bdag la nor stsol cig stsol cig gzhi tshug

/nub byang du/ oṃmukhen+d+rāyamamadhanaṃdehidehiswāhā/ gdong gi dbang po bdag la nor stsol cig stsol cig gzhi tshug /byang shar du/ oṃtsaren+d+rāyamamadhanaṃdehidehiswāhā/ spyod pa'i dbang po bdag la nor stsol cig stsol cig gzhi tshug /zhes pa rnams 'dod gsol dang bcas pa bri/ ༈ /yum 'khor gyi shar mdun nas chos skor mgo phyir bstan du/ mu khyud gnyis pa la rten 'brel snying po| gsum pa la dbyangs gsal/ yab 'khor gyi shar mdun nas mgo nang bstan bon skor du/ mu khyud gnyis pa la rten 'brel snying po/ gsum pa la dbyangs gsal/ 'khor lo gnyis ka'i mu khyud bzhi pa la rdo rje'i phreng ba dang*/ phyi rol tu yum la me ri chos skor yab la me ri bon skor du 'bar ba bri/ gtso bo'i sngags gnyis kyi dbu nub tu bstan pa yin no/ /rten chung ba la 'khor lo de tsam mi shong na lte ba 'dab brgyad sngags dang bcas pa bri/ phyi'i mu khyud rnams dor/ de tsam yang mi shong ba shin tu chung ba la dzaṃ dgu bam̐ dgu tsam yang rung bas so// ༈ /gnod sbyin dgyes pa'i 'khor lo ni/ sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar sngags mgo rgyab tu bstan pa'i zhal bzhi pa'i sngags oṃsum+bhani sogs dang*| mdun shar gyi 'dab mar pad+ma/ chos skor gyi lhor 'khor lo/ nub tu gdugs/ byang du bum pa/ shar lhor rgyal mtshan/ lho nub tu dpal be'u/ nub byang du gser nya/ byang shar du dung rnams mgo phyir bstan bri/ ༈ /zhabs sdom gyi 'khor lo ni/ sna tshogs rdo rje phyogs mdog gi lte bar su pra tiṣ+ṭha bris pa dag go// zhib tu ni dpe'u ris las rtogs par bya'o| |de ltar 'khor lo rnams legs par bris zin nas dri bzang gis byug cing tshon gyis legs par kha bsgyur la/ yab yum gyi 'khor lo gza' skar bzang por rin po che'i snod 'bru sman dar zab rin po ches bkang ba'i steng du 'khor lo gnyis so sor bsham/

dkar gtor gnyis dang chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga rol mo bsham/ 'khor lo gu gul khro bo'i sngags bzlas pas bdug |yungs kar gyis brab/ bgegs bskrad/ rang lhar gsal ba'i las sngags kyis 'khor lo bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rdo rje'i sa gzhi ra ba dra ba gur bla bre mda'i dra ba ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su/ 'khor lo gnyis rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ lte ba ge sar mu khyud gong ras dang bcas pa ser po kha dog dwangs shing 'od zer 'phro ba gnyis las/ yab 'khor gyi lte ba dang 'dab ma rnams la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba re re'i gdan dang*/ yum 'khor gyi lte ba dang 'dab ma rnams la nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od 'bar ba re re'i gdan dang bcas pa gnyis las/ yum 'khor gyi lte ba dang 'dab ma brgyad la baṃ las 'bras kyi snye ma baṃ ser pos mtshan pa dgu dang*/ yab 'khor gyi lte ba dang 'dab ma brgyad la dzaṃ ser las shing tog bi dza pū ra ka ser po dzaṃ ser pos mtshan pa dgu ste/ de rnams la 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phu+ul/ sems can thams cad kyi dbul phong gi sdug bsngal bsal/ tshur 'dus sa bon phyag mtshan dang bcas pa la thim/ yongs su gyur pa las/ yum 'khor gyi lte bar nor rgyun ma dzam+bu nā da'i kha dog lta bu/ phyag g.yas shing thog bi dza pū ra ka dang bcas pa'i mchog sbyin/ g.yon thugs kar 'bras kyi snye ma bsnams pa/ bud med sgyu ma'i nga rgyal gyis 'gying ba/ 'dab ma g.yas skor gyi shar du zla 'od ma/ lhor byin ma/ nub tu rab byin ma/ byang du 'phags ma/ shar lhor rab tu bzang mo/ lho nub tu sbas ma/ nub byang du mdzes ma/ byang shar du dbyangs can ma rnams sku mdog dang phyag mtshan gtso mo lta bu/ gtso 'khor rnams zhabs gnyis skyil krung phyed pas rin po che 'bar ba'i tshogs skyug pa'i pad+ma'i gter mnan pa/

yab 'khor gyi lte bar dzaṃ bha la gser btso ma lta bu/ phyag g.yas shing thog bi dza pū ra ka dang bcas pa'i mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon rin po che sna tshogs skyug pa'i ne'u le 'dzin pa/ ut+pala'i phreng ba'i do shal can 'dab ma brgyad la g.yon skor du rim pa bzhin/ shar du nor bu bzang po/ lhor gang ba bzang po/ nub tu nor sbyin/ byang du rnam thos sras/ shar lhor rol pa'i phreng ba/ lho nub tu 'jam po 'khyil pa/ nub byang du gdong gi dbang po/ byang shar du spyod pa'i dbang po rnams sku mdog dang phyag mtshan dzaṃ bha la lta bu/ zhabs rnams kyis dung gi tshogs dang pad+ma'i tshogs kyi gdong gi gter mnan pa/ yab yum gtso 'khor thams cad kyang rin po che'i cod pan dang*/ rgyan phreng sna tshogs dang*/ dar sna tshogs pa'i na bza' dang con pan gyis mdzes pa lha thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan pa rnams las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa'i tshogs rnams pheṃ/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim par gyur/ slar yang rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ nas/ shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ| zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lhas bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma gyen du 'khyil ba las gtso bo yab yum la rin 'byung*/ 'khor so sor yab yum so sos dbu brgyan/ dbang lha rnams rang la bstims/ oṃ bā su dha ri ṇ+yai dzaṃ bha la dza len+d+ra ya sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ nas/ shapada'i bar sbyar bas mchod/ gtor ma gnyis byin rlabs spyi 'gro ltar byas la/

yab yum gtso 'khor rnams kyis sngags so so'i mjug tu/ i maṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ btags pa yab yum gnyis la nyer gcig re/ 'khor rnams la gsum res dbul/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la/ nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod kyi bar bya/ lha mo gang gis yid la dran tsam gyis// phun tshogs rin chen nor dang 'bru rnams dang*// rkang bzhi phyugs kyi dngos grub ster mdzad ma// bsam 'phel nor rgyun ster la phyag 'tshal bstod// nor gyi dbang phyug rin chen gter mnga' zhing*// gnod sbyin nor 'chang mang po kun gyi rje// byang phyogs skyong ba'i mgon po dzaṃ bha la// dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod// ser sna'i las kyi me yis gdung ba rnams// skye dang skye bar khyod la skyabs su mchi// rin chen bdud rtsi'i gter gyi char rgyun gyis// sems can dbul ba'i sdug bsngal zhi bar mdzod// ces bstod nas/ yab yum gyi sngags brgya stong sogs dang*/ 'khor gyi sngags rnams nyer gcig sogs ci 'grub bzla/ de nas lte ba dang phyogs mtshams su mar dkar dang sha ka ra'i lde gus byugs la/ yab yum gtso 'khor rnams phyogs mi 'chol bar zhal sbyar nas/ lha yab yum rnams rjes su chags pa'i bde ba snyoms 'jug la longs spyod par bsam zhing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod cing 'khor lo zhal sbyar/ dar skud ser pos rgya gram du dkri zhing so so'i kha byang dang gzhug tshul man ngag lag len mthong rgyud ltar kha byang btab/ dar ser pos dril nas dben par bzhag /༈ /de nas srog shing zhi ba rnams la/ byang chub ljon shing ngam/ tsan+dan nam/ shug pa dri zhim po las byas pa/ drag po rnams la/ tsher ma can gyi shing ngam/ ro bsregs pa'i 'gal dum mam/ dur khrod kyi shing las byas pa/ de rnams gang yin yang rul 'khyog /gas grum/ 'bus zos sogs kyi skyon med cing rtsa rtse ma log pa cung zad gru bzhir byas pa/

de'ang sku'i gtsug tor nas pad gdan gyi bar dang*/ mchod rten la tog nas rmang dge'i bar du slebs pa dri bzang gis byugs pa'i mdun ngos su/ spyi bor haṃ man ngag ltar bris pa/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ lte bar hoḥ gsang bar k+ṣa rnams dang*/ phyogs bzhir oṃbadz+ra.āyuṣeswāhā/ oṃsarbabid+yāswāhā/ oṃsupratiṣ+ṭhabadz+reswāhā/ rnams tshar re re bris/ srog shing gi dbus thugs kar sgrib sel gyi sngags ni/ namobhagawatāṃnab+napatīnāṃsamyak+saṃbud+dhakoṭiniyutashatasahasrāṇaṃgaṅgānadībālukāsamānāṃnamaḥsarbanibaranibiskaṃbhinibodhisatwāya.oṃturuturu sarba.āwaraṇabishodhanisarbatathāgata ayurbalānibipulenirmalesarbasid+dhinamaḥkṛtebharabharasarbasatwa.awalokini.oṃsarbanibaraṇabiskaṃbhinimamasarbapāpaṃbishodhaniswāhā/ srog shing gi dbus su gzhug rgyu dri med 'od kyi mchod rten yo byad byin rlabs ni/ oṃsarbatathāgatamalabishodhanigan+dhabilesanabarepratisaṃskāratathāgatedhātudharedharadharasan+dharasan+dharasarbatathāgata.adhiṣ+ṭhāna.adhiṣ+ṭhiteswāhā/ oṃbadz+ra.āyuṣeswāhā/ srog shing gi phyogs bzhir gzhug rgyu dri med 'od kyi sngags dgu bcu rtsa dgu pa ni/ oṃsarbatathāgatabipulayaṣ+ṭimaṇikanakarādzabibhuṣitayaṣ+ṭidhurudhurusaman+tabilokitesarasar sarbapāpaṃbishodhanibodhanisaṃbodhaniprawarayaṣ+ṭibarem ṇidh+wadzesu+urutsiramamashud+dhehūm̐hūm̐swāhā/ srog shing gi dbus 'phang lor gzhug rgyu dri med 'od kyi mchod pa dang skor ba'i sngags ni/ namonab+nabatīnāṃtathāgatagaṃgānadībālukasamānāṃkoṭiniyuta shatasahasrāṇaṃ.oṃpūreṇipūretsālanitsalemorikuritsalabīraswāhā/ srog shing gi rtse mor gzhug rgyu rnam rgyal gyi sngags ni/ oṃbh+rūṃswāhā/ snying khar/ oṃ.amṛtāyurdadeswāhā/ mgo bor rig pa chen mo'i sngags ni/ oṃsarbabid+yāswāhā/ srog shing gi rtsa bar gzhug rgyu dri med 'od kyi snying po ni/

namaḥsastasastānāṃsamyak+saṃbud+dhakoṭīnāṃparishud+dhamanasi.abh+yaḥtsit+tepratiṣ+ṭhatānāṃ namobhagawate.amṛta.ayuḥs+yatathāgatas+ya.oṃsarbatathāgatāḥshud+dhe.ayuḥbishod+dhanisaṃharasaṃharaṇasaṃharasaṃharasarbatathāgatabīr+yabalaṃnapratisaṃhara.ayuḥsārasārasarbatathāgatasamayabodhibodhibud+dh+yabud+dh+yabodhiyabodhiyasarbasatwānāṃ sarbapāpāṃbaraṇabishud+dhebigatamalāmilabhayesubud+dhebud+dhehuruhuruswāhā/ oṃsupratiṣ+ṭhabadz+reswāhā/ de nas gnas yig rgyas par bri ba ni/ gtsug tor la/ oṃnamobadz+radharayahūm̐namobud+dhāyanamodharmāyanamaḥsaṃghāya.oṃnamaḥsaman+tabud+dhānāṃ.apratihatahūm̐hūm̐phaṭa/ mdzod spu la/ oṃhehetiṣ+ṭhatiṣ+ṭhaban+dhaban+dhadharayadharayanirun+dhanirun+dhasemasacanakunagyi sdugabasngalakunadangarnamagayengakuna.ur+ṇamaṇiswāhā/ spyan gnyis la/ oṃmaṇidharihūm̐phaṭa/ snyan gnyis la/ oṃdruṃdruṃswāhā/ shangs la/ oṃrbardashraswāhā/ oṃdhiswāhā/ oṃsarbatathāgatoṣ+ṇīṣabar+ṇamudrānisarbatathāgatedharmadhātubibhuṣitādhiṣ+ṭhatehuruhuruhūm̐hūm̐swāhā/ o+oṃhūm̐trāṃhrīḥ.āḥ mūṃlāṃmā'aṃpāṃtāṃ/ zhal la/ oṃsarba.asamayaswāhā/ lkog mar/ oṃsadhebh+yeswāhā/ mgul la| oṃ.ārolikahūm̐/ lte bar/ oṃhobadz+ra.abaswāhā/ gtsug tor la/ namaḥsarbabud+dhebh+yaḥ.oṃnamaḥsaman+tabud+dhānāṃhūm̐hūm̐/ klad par/ oṃsteyad+dhisarbatathāgatahṛdayagarbahedzagadharmadhātugarbahesaṃhara.ayuḥ saṃshodhayapāpaṃsarbatathāgatahṛdayasaman+tatathāgatoṣ+ṇīṣabimalebibud+dheswāhā/ dpral bar/ badz+rahohūm̐phaṭa/ spyan gnyis la/ oṃrurutiṣ+ṭhasid+dhilotsanisarba.ar+thasādhaniswāhā/ mdzod spur/ oṃ.āhūm̐hrīḥ.oṃbadz+rahohūm̐phaṭa/ smin ma gnyis la/ badz+rahariswāhā/ rna ba gnyis la/ badz+rahodhaswāhā/ sna la/ badz+radwibyagateyeswāhā/ mchu la/ badz+rahohūm̐swāhā/ lce la/ badz+rahotiswāhā/ mjing pa la/ badz+raharaswāhā/ mgrin pa la/ badz+rahoriswāhā/ snying la/ badz+raropaswāhā/ mchan khung gnyis la/ badz+rahodataswāhā/ rtsib logs g.yas la/ badz+rahobaṃtaswāhā/ rtsib logs g.yon la/

badz+rahobaṃbiswāhā/ rked par/ badz+rashushuyeswāhā/ gsang gnas su/ badz+raho.abaṃswāhā/ zhabs gnyis la/ badz+rahopayeswāhā/ sku byings la/ oṃbadz+ra.ayuḥṣeswāhā/ byin pa g.yas la/ oṃbadz+ragarbaheswāhā/ byin pa g.yon la/ oṃsarbabaṃt+yaswāhā/ lte bar/ oṃhobadz+ra.abaswāhā/ zhes pa rnams gnas yig spyir grags che ba rnams bris pa yin la/ gzhan yang skye mched byin rlabs ni/ mig gnyis la k+ṣiṃ re re/ rna ba gnyis la dz+riṃ re re/ sna la khaṃ/ lce la gaṃ/ rkang pa gnyis baṃ re re/ mtshan ma'i rdo rje la hūm̐/ spyi gtsug tu haṃ// dpral bar 'khor lo'i lte bar oṃ/ mgrin par pad+ma'i lte bar āḥ/ snying gar nyi ma'i dbus su hūm̐ dang*/ pad+ma'i lte bar raṃ rnams bri'o// gzhan yang zab mo rdo rje'i theg pa rnams nas gsungs pa'i skye mched byin rlabs rgyas pa rnams ni/ ༈ /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo nas/ gtsug tor dang spyi bor/ oṃ hṝṃshikhāyaibauṣaṭa/ smin mtshams dang dpral bar/ oṃhūm̐ siraseswāhā/ mig gnyis la/ oṃ hrāṃnetrāyawaṣaṭa/ mgrin par/ oṃhūm̐grīwāyaswāhā/ thugs kar/ oṃ hṝṃhṛdayāyanamaḥ lte bar/ oṃ hṝṃnabhīnamohoḥ yan lag thams cad la/ oṃ hṝṃkabatsāyahūm̐/ zhes pa rnams so// ༈ /yang 'khor lo sdom pa nas/ gtsug tor dang spyi bor/ haṃswāhāhu/ smin mtshams dang dpral bar/ namahihriṃhrīṃ/ thugs kar/ oṃhahaṃyaṃ/ yan lag thams cad la/ phaṭahaṃ/ phrag pa gnyis la/ bauṣaṭahe/ zhes rnams so// phag mo nas/ gtsug tor dang dpral bar/ huṃhūm̐/ zhal la/ hrīṃmaṃ/ lte bar/ oṃbaṃ/ zhes pa rnams so/ ༈ /yang dgyes pa rdo rje nas/ smin mtshams dang dpral bar iṃ/ mig gnyis la maṃ/ rna ba la dw-i/ zhal la/ namaḥsarbatathāgatebh+yaḥsarbamukhebh+yobadz+ra.ānan swāhā/ thugs kar āḥrnams so// yang gsang 'dus nas/ smin mtshams dang dpral bar kaṃ/ mig gnyis la k+ṣiṃ/ rna ba la dz+riṃ/ sna la khaṃ/ ljags la gaṃ rnams so// ༈ /yang spyod rgyud rnams nas/ gtsug tor dang spyi bor/

namaḥsarbatathāgatebh+yaḥsarbamukhebh+yaḥsarbathākhaṃdzaṃ/ smin mtshams dang dpral bar/ namaḥsarbatathāgatebh+yaḥsarbatathākhatriswāhā/ namaḥsarba tathāgatebh+yaḥsarbamukhebh+yaḥsarbathāmaṃ/ mdzod spur/ namaḥsarbatathāgatebh+yaḥtathāgatashaparipūratsin+tamaṇirādzabadz+rahūm̐swāhā/ sna la maṃ/ ljags la/ namaḥsarbatathāgatebh+yaḥsarbamukhebh+yaḥ sarbatathāgatasat+yadharmapratiṣ+ṭhatebadz+rāṃgabud+dhaparaswastibayūhālaṃkaragarbahabadz+radzihwahūm̐bhagawatīsarbasatwasan+toṣaṇakariswāhā/ tshems la/ namaḥsaman+tabud+dhānāṃtathāgatamahā daṃṣ+ṭasārasāgrapaṃpra bhākasarbatathāgatabiṣaya.oṃbhabaswāhā/ mgrin par/ namaḥsaman+tabud+dhānāṃhihaswāhā/ thugs kar/ namaḥsarbatathāgatebh+yaḥ sarbamukhebh+yaḥsarbathābipulabadz+ratsan+ḍaswāhā/ namaḥsaman+tabud+dhānāṃyogayoganīshwarabañdzarakeswāhā// namaḥsarbatathāgatebh+yaḥ sarbamukhebh+yaḥsarbathāsarbadharmasamateprābakabadz+rasatwaswāhā/ namaḥsaman+tabud+dhānāṃ bud+dhadhariṇismṛtibaladānakāridharadharadharayadharayasarbabhagabatī.ākarabati.asamaswāhā/ nu+u mjing la/ namaḥsarbatathāgatebh+yaḥ sarbamukhebh+yaḥsarba thāhasahasadhakadhakatsaratsarahaṃpratsaṇ+ḍabadz+raswāhā/ lte bar/ namaḥsarbatathāgatebh+yaḥsarbamukhebh+yaḥsarbathāhṝṃ/ yan lag thams cad la/ namaḥsarbatathāgatebh+yaḥsarbamu khebh+yaḥbadz+ragrasamesamasamabishwarūpadharaswāhā/ namaḥsaman+tabud+dhānāṃ.abidabi.aswāhāḥ namaḥsarbatathāgatebh+yaḥsarbamukhebh+yaḥ tsaṇ+ḍibadz+ra.atsiswaraṇaswāhā/ namaḥsaman+tabud+dhānāṃraṃraswāhā/ namaḥsarbatathāgatebh+yaḥsarbamukhebh+yaḥsarbathā.ānamaḥsarbatathāgatebh+yaḥ sarbamukhebh+yaḥsarbathāk+ṣaṃ/ phyag la/ namaḥsarbatathāgatebh+yaḥsarbamukhebh+yaḥ badz+ragrasamebishwarūpadharaswāhā/ namaḥsarbatathāgatebh+yaḥsarbamukhebh+yaḥ sarbathā.oṃnamaḥsaman+tabud+dhānāṃ.oṃ.āḥswāhā/ oṃts+tshin+dats+tshin+dahanahanatsakradīp+tahūm̐/ namaḥsarbatathāgatebh+yaḥsarbamukhebh+yaḥsarbathā.oṃ/ zhabs la/ namaḥsarbatathāgatebh+yaḥsarbamukhebh+yaḥsarbathābatsitrigatiswāhā/ namaḥsarbatathāgatebh+yaḥsarbamukhebh+yaḥsarbathā.oṃ/ gdan la/ namaḥsarbatathāgatebh+yaḥsarbathābadz+rapad+motabhababadz+rās nabadz+radadaswāhā/ 'og gzhi la/ namaḥsaman+tabud+dhānāṃsaṃsaswāhā/

bya rgyud nas/ gtsug tor dang spyi bor/ oṃ.oṃbadz+raswāhā/ oṃtedzadz+wal sarba ar+thasādhakasid+dh+yatsin+tamaṇirat+nahūm̐/ smin mtshams dang dpral bar/ namaḥsarbatathāgatebh+yaḥsarbamukhebh+yaḥsarbathānilam+batikitiswāhā/ mdzod spur/ oṃhehetiṣ+ṭhatiṣ+ṭhabhan+dhaban+dhadharayadharayanirun+dhanirun+dha ur+ṇamaṇiswāhā/ tshems la/ namaḥsaman+tabadz+riṇītiṣ+ṭhahetraṭatraṭamaṭamaṭadz+walanakhaṃkhareswāhā/ phyag la/ oṃdhunatsit+taraṇaṃ/ oṃlokapāla.adhiṣ+ṭhitāṃbarāyadharamahā nubanudhāpātraswāhā/ snam sbyar la/ oṃrak+ṣarak+ṣamāṃsarbabud+dha.adhiṣ+ṭhate.āt+matsibaraswāhā/ zhes sogs gnas yig phung khams skye mched byin rlabs rnams rgyas na thams cad tshang ba'am/ bsdu na rang rigs dang bstun pa skabs sbyar sman sku la ru shing dang 'jim pa'i bar du bri/ lugs ma dang*/ brdungs ma chen po la nang du gnas so sor bri ba'am yang na bris la brlan/ lha chung ngu la gnas yig thams cad bris la nang du gzhug /mchod rten la stod smad bar gsum du le tshan du bris la skabs sbyar dgod/ gzhan yang gnod sbyin bang mdzod du gzhug pa'i brtan g.yo zhu ba dang mi zhu ba'i khams las grub pa'i rin po che sna tshogs/ sman dri bzang*/ 'bru dang shing thog sna tshogs/ ja gos dar bza' dang btung ba'i rigs/ rten chen po la go khrab la sogs pa mdor na lus can rnams kyis nye bar longs spyad byar gyur pa'i dngos po yod do cog thams cad ma tshang ba med pa legs par 'tshogs par bya zhing*/ khyad par lnga tshan lnga'i rdzas med du mi rung la/ gzhan yang mtshams dar dmar po dang*/ zhabs dar ser po la sogs pa nye bar mkho ba thams cad ma tshang ba med par 'dzom par bya'o/ ༈ /gnyis pa gzhug pa'i tshul ni/ gang du yan lag lnga pa'i 'bras bu rab tu dge ba'i dus la bab cing de dang rjes su mthun pa'i tarkā lar bab pa'i tshe/ gnas dben par sku dang thugs kyi rten ring bsrel gzhug bya de nyid gu gul gyis bdug /yungs kar gyis brab/

khro bo'i sngags bzlas pas bgegs bskrad/ dri bzang gi lde gus nang du zhal zhal legs par bya/ de'ang rten chung ngu rnams spyi tshugs su bzhugs su bcug nas ring bsrel yas rim nas dbul/ chen po rnams ni gser dngul zangs lcags sogs lugs dang brdungs pa dag la ni thog ma nyid nas mas rim du 'bul zhing de dang mthun pa'i lhu dum bsgrigs nas gzer gdab la/ 'jim pa las byas pa rnams ni sngon du srog shing btsugs te gzungs gzhug rnams mas rim gyis ru shing gi nang du 'bul lo/ ༈ /'bul ba'i lag len ni/ srog shing 'bul dus bklag par bya ba dri med 'od kyi mchod rten rab gnas kyi sngags ni/ tad+yathā/ oṃbipulamimaleprabaradzinabaresarasarasarbatathā gtadhātugarbahesat+yādhiṣ+ṭhateswāhā.āyan+tubhūbanaṃswāhāhasarbadebānāṃ.ābahayāmibud+dhādhiṣ+ṭhānasamayeswāhā/ zhes brjod nas srog shing drang por dbul/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel yod na de dang bla ma rnams kyi yungs 'bru lta bu'i ring bsrel rnams phyogs gcig tu sman dang dri bzang po dang rin po che'i phur mar bcas pa dang*/ chos sku'i ring bsrel dri bzang pos bris pa rnams bsdoms te rten gyi gtsug tor ram mchod rten gyi tog gi nang du gzhug /de'i 'og tu bla ma brgyud pa'i mtshan 'bum dang bla ma rnams kyi gdung la sogs pa spel gyin gzhug */ de rnams sku gzugs kyi mgul yan chad dang mchod rten gyi bre yan chad la shong bar bya/ de 'og mchod rten gyi bum stod dang sku'i thugs ka'i stod cha la bla med las/ gnyis med kyi rgyud rnams dang bla ma rnams kyi sku bal gyi ring bsrel rnams gzhug /de'i 'og tu ma rgyud dang de'i 'og tu pha rgyud/ lha'i thugs ka'am mchod rten gyi bum pa'i dbus su gzungs chen bzhi po dri med mdun/ rnam rgyal g.yas/ rgyan 'bum rgyab/ gsang ba ring bsrel g.yon du gzhug

/de'i 'og tu rnal 'byor gyi rgyud/ de'i 'og spyod rgyud/ de'i 'og bya rgyud kyi gzungs rnams gzhug /sku tshad che ba gzungs kyis mi gang ba rnams la de dag gi mthar sāts+tsha rab gnas dang ldan pa la sogs pas bskang*/ mchod rten gyi bang rim dang sku'i skyil krung gi nang du rgyud dang*/ de'i 'og theg pa chen po'i mdo sde/ de 'og 'dul ba la sogs pa rnams bklag thabs su dbu zhabs dang rgyab mdun ma log par gzhug /de'i 'og rten gyi skyil krung gi smad cha dang mchod rten gyi rmang dge'i nang du dpal mgon po nag po dang*/ lha mo/ tshogs kyi bdag po/ rnam thos sras/ dzaṃ bha la sogs nor lha dang*/ gtsang ris kyi dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga la sogs pa chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs rnams kyi gzungs rnams kyang dbus su mgon po dang*/ de dag gi mtha' skor du lha mo sogs/ de'i mthar nor lha/ de'i mthar gtsang ris rnams skor thabs su gtso 'khor gyi tshul du gzhug /gzungs rnams kyi chad lhag gi nyes pa zhi ba'i phyir stod smad bar thams cad du rig pa phug ron gyi sngags tshar mang du bris pa dang*/ rab gnas brtan pa'i phyir rten 'brel snying po dang su pra tiṣ+ṭha rnams mang du bris pa stod smad thams cad du khyab par gzhug /nang gzhug gi mtshams thams cad dri bzang po'i phye mas khyab par bya zhing spos dang sman dang rin po che la sogs pa khrol bu dang dum bur byas pa sil mar gzhug /gzungs gzhug rnams dang srog shing gi rting pa khod snyoms shing gzungs rnams gyen du 'grengs pa/ mi 'phyug cing mi 'gyel ba gnas ma 'chol bar dam zhing mkhregs pa rlung mi 'chor ba dang*/ yun ring por lon yang nang gzhug rnams brdab 'khrol dang gnas 'phyug pa sogs mi 'ong ba'i ca ga lag tshags kyis thon cing yid gzhungs par bya/ stod smad bar rnams su smon lam gsol gdab bstan 'gror sman pa'i lhag bsam bzang pos nye bar sbyar ba rnams mtshams mtshams su gzhug

/de rnams zin nas mtshams dar dmar pos legs par bcad la rlung mi 'chor bar bya/ ༈ /de'i 'og tu gnod sbyin 'khor lo yab steng dang yum 'og /yab yum gyi sngags mgo rten gyi rgyab tu bstan la gnas mi 'chol zhing mi 'khrugs par khod snyoms shing*/ g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab tu nye ring dang gzhogs g.yon med par legs par bkram la dar ser po'i na bza' dang bcas te gzhug /de nas mchod rten gyi seng khri dang sku'i pad gdan nam 'bol la sogs pa'i nang rnams lnga tshan lnga'i rdzas gtso bor byas pa'i sngar bshad pa'i gnod sbyin bang mdzod du nyer bsdogs byas pa'i skye dgu rnams kyi longs spyad byar gyur to cog ras dkar gtsang mas ma 'dres par so sor gtums la gnas mi 'chol zhing khrag khrog med par dam du gzhug /de dag gi bar rnams su bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi kha na ma tho ba spangs pa chos ldan gyi longs spyod rgya chen po 'byung ba dang mu ge'i bskal pa las thar ba sogs kyi smon lam gsol gdab bris pa'ang gzhug /de'i 'og gnod sbyin dgyes pa'i 'khor lo bkra shis rtags brgyad rgyab mdun ma log pa kha steng du phyogs par gzhag /de'i 'og zhabs sdom rdo rje rgya gram yang kha steng du phyogs pa phyogs ma 'dzol bar dgab/ de'i 'og dar ras la sogs pa'i tshal dang bcas pas chu rlung srog chags sogs mi thar ba'i ca ga legs po bya/ de'i 'og rten chen po yin na gri mda' mdung la sogs pa mtshon cha'i bye brag rnams bcug na 'khrug rtsod dang mtshon gyi bskal pa nyams par gsungs pa'ang byas na shin tu legs/ de'i 'og zangs zhabs la sogs pas 'grig cing dam la yid 'phrog pa'i bkod pas mdzes par bya'o// yang gzungs gzhug pa'i lag len 'ga' zhig tu sku'i gtsug tor tu gdugs dkar/ dpung par dpung bzang*/ phyag la phyag rdor dbang bskur/ lte bar legs grub/ gsang bar don zhags/

zhabs la 'byung 'dul sogs so sor gzhug par gsungs mod/ de dag ni ston pas gzungs de rnams gsungs pa'i tshe gnas de dang de dag las 'od zer bkye ba sogs la bsam par snang ste/ de ltar na zhal nas gsungs pa'i rgyud dang*/ gzungs rnams sku'i zhal gyi nang kho nar gzhug dgos par thal bas ha cang nongs so// gzungs rnams kyi mjug tu 'dod gsol rgyas pa sbyor na 'di ltar bri bar bya'o/ ༈ /hitasukhash+tsa.ākarabud+dhas+yashāsanarat+nemaṃsarbadashakālābas+thānodāyabistāras+thānaḥ phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che 'di phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa dang*/ sarba gu rukal+yāṇamitradūrabādukaṃdzībanād+dhi yan+te bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen thams cad yun ring du 'tsho zhing gzhes pa dang*/ sūtraman+t+rabhaṣaṇa sād+dhanas+yashāsanagrahaṇamahā.ūrdzakālārītaḥ mdo sngags bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa 'dzin pa la brtson pa chen pos dus 'da' ba dang*/ dashadik+saṅghasan+nipātasamudrasam+bharasarbasapariwāramānapratikulatrishik+ṣa.a nuṣ+ṭhanas+yasādh+nanadashadharmasarbasādhanaṃwar+dhanaṃbistārabhawa/ phyogs bcu'i dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyang thugs mthun zhing bslab gsum nan tan gyis sgrub pa 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang*/ tewah+yamadh+yayoḥsarba.apak+ṣa.upashān+tiṃkur+wan+tu/ de dag la phyi nang gi mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ āt+matsabar+yān+tasarbasatwas+yakarmabipākahāyanasaṃsāradurgatahetutsahāyanasarbapāpanoshreya s+yakar+yaṃtur+ṇābetashud+dhakur+wan+tu/ bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi las dang rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu 'khor ba dang ngan 'gro'i rgyu dang 'bras bu sdig pa mi dge ba'i las thams cad myur du byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ dānapatisapariwāras+ya.ayuḥpuṇ+yaidhanaṃwar+dhanaṃbistārash+tsawah+yamadh+yayoḥ sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi tshe dang bsod nams nor thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang*/

sarba.apak+ṣarogagrahaheṭhaṇasarba.upa shīn+taṃkur+wan+tu/ phyi dang nang gi mi mthun pa'i phyogs nad gdon 'tshe ba thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes so sor sbyar/ de tsam mi nus na skabs thog tu gang bar bya'o/ yang bris sku la gzhan pa'i ring bsrel gzhug tshul med kyang rgyab yig 'bri ba'am lha bzo pas skya bris zin pa'i rjes su phung khams skye mched byin rlabs sogs gang 'os dang*/ sku'i nang du bla ma brgyud pa nas bzung chos skyong gi bar gang thad shong tshod dang bstun pa dang*/ chos sku'i ring bsrel dang gzungs chen bzhi'i snying po nye snying dang*/ yedharma/ supratiṣ+ṭha/ sarba bid+yā/ ayuṣe/ sogs dgos gal che ba rnams skabs bstun dri bzang byin rlabs sogs kyis 'bri/ de'i steng du tshon rtsis byug na don la gnas par 'gyur la/ der ma shong ba rnams dkyus ltar rgyab yig tu bris kyang rung ba yin no// de ltar rgyu'i rnam pa dpangs dang rgya tshad che chung ji ltar na'ang phyag tshad/ gzungs gzhug sogs mdo rgyud nas gsungs pa rnams paṇa grub tshad ldan gyis legs par bkral ba'i lugs ji lta bar byas pa'i rten de 'dra ba yun ring po ma lon par mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i rdo rje slob dpon/ ltar snang dang khe grags kyi chos thal ba bzhin tu spangs pa dag gis/ tshad ldan gyi rgyud sde chen po'i dkyil 'khor du cho ga yan lag ma nyams pas rab tu gnas pa legs par bgyis pa'i rten rnams ni bdag cag gi ston pa yongs su mya ngan 'das pa'i rgyal tshab dam pa/ bstan pa rin po che yun ring du gnas pa'i ma mo/ lha dang bcas pa'i skye dgu 'khor ba dang ngan song la rgyab kyis phyogs shing mngon par mtho ba dang nges par legs pa'i go 'phang dam pa don du gnyer ba rnams kyis tshogs rnam gnyis rdzogs shing*/ mchod bstod bkur sti phu dud du bya ba'i 'os dam par gyur pa'i mchod sdong chen por 'gyur ba ni bde bar gshegs pas mdo sngags kyi theg pa rnams su yang dang yang du bzlas te gsungs pa nyid yin la/

de las gzhan du gyur pa'i rang 'dod khe grags rnyed brtson chos brgyad kyi bsam pa mig sman gyi kha dog ltar gnag pa snying gi dbus su lan gcig ma yin pa shi phur thebs par bcangs nas/ kha mkhas dang gze zong gis don gnyis 'grub pa'i rgyu yin par smra zhing*/ kha na ma tho ba'i bzang rdzu rku 'phrog gzhogs slong mgo skor gyis bsgrubs pa'i dngos po rnams la phyag tshad dang dngos 'gal gyi rten mthong ba kho nas nyes pa'i tshogs skyed par byed pa 'jigs su rung ba dag bzhengs pa'i nang du/ rnam par ma dag pa'i gzungs dang blun po dad pa'i rjes su 'brangs pas gos lham sogs ngan skyug gi gnas rnams nga'i bla ma'i na bza' gsang chen yin zer ba dang*/ phung po mes ma tshig pa'i klad pa dang*/ nang khrol gyi dum bu thal sol gyi phra rgyan can tshul khrims kyi dri ma rul dri la re ba'i tshogs bcug nas/ nga'i bla ma'i thugs ljags spyan gsum po sogs me thub la bzhugs pa rnams bzhugs su gsol yod do// zhes phyi'i phyag tshad dang bral ba'i nang ngan skyug gis bskangs ba de nyid slob dpon tshad ldan rtswa bzhin dor nas rang dang rigs 'gre ba'i slob dpon dbang dang rim gnyis dam tshig gis stongs pa/ zog rdzu dang rnyed brtson chos brgyad kyis byas lo thos lo 'ba' zhig don du gnyer ba dag bos nas| rten de 'dra ba'i mdun du ma dag pa'i dkyil 'khor dang mchod pa bshams/ rgyud kyi dgongs pa ni nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon rlung gis gtor ba bzhin gar song cha med du btang*/ rab tu gnas pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang cho ga'i yan lag rnam par dag pa'i ngo tshab tu/ skad sgra dang rol mo gdangs dbyangs sogs chos brgyad gtso bor bton pa'i cho nge drag po dbyar rnga ltar bsgrags nas rab tu gnas pa legs par grub bo// zhes log pa'i yon bdag gis log pa'i rten bzhengs pa log pa'i slob dpon gyis log pa'i rab gnas bgyis pas bstan pa dang sems can rnams yang dag par bslus nas yon mchod thams cad rdo rje'i dmyal khams chen por khyu nyo le ku ti re 'gro ba rnams las/

yang dag par 'phags pa'i phyir kho bos bstan 'gror sman zhing blo ldan don gnyer rnams la phan pa'i blo kho nas dpyad pa gsum gyis dag par bgyis pa nyid yin pas/ phyis nas phyi mo 'di la mos pas 'bri bshu byed pa rnams kyis kyang sngags tshig rnams la bcos slad mi mdzad pa dang*/ khyad par 'di'i sngags rnams phyi mo rnam par dag la gtugs shing 'bad pas dag par bgyis pa kho na yin pas lag len 'di ltar mdzad pa rnams kyis kyang 'di kho na bzhin ma gtogs sngags tshig bcos mi mdzad pa nyid du gsol zhing*/ yang lugs 'di ltar ma dag par dgongs pa rnams kyis 'di nyid la bcos bslad mi mdzad par gzhan dag rnams kyi rjes su 'brang bar zhu'o/ /smras pa/ 'jig rten gsum gtso yan lag bdun ldan rdo rje 'dzin pas rgyud sde rgya mtsho las gsungs shing*| |mtha' bral don ston bde gshegs skyob des theg chen mdo sder yang nas yang du rab bsngags pa// gang zhig tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs slad du bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gzugs dang ni chos sku'i mtshan ma rmad byung ba// tshad ldan bzhengs pa'i snying po dam par ring bsrel lnga po gzhug par bgyis na bsod nams tshogs rab thob par gsungs// byis pa'i skye bos bye ma'i phung po la// bde gshegs gzugs brnyan gyi na bgyis la'ang*// rmad byung bsod nams thob bar gsungs mthong nas// mdo sngags gzhung brgya'i legs bshad dpang byas te// gang gis rten mchog bsgrubs pa'i bsod nams phul// nor 'dzin rdul gyi grangs las ches mang ba'i// phan yon mthong nas legs bshad 'di bgyis so// baiḍūr chen po'i rigs las mching bu dang*// mching bu'i tshogs las dgos 'dod kun 'byung ba'i// gshis sam babs med de las de mi 'byung*// de bzhin legs bshad rnams la dri ma dang*// nyes par bshad la rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ci// mdo sngags rgyal ba'i dgongs don rnams// dor nas gang byung dpe 'ong gi// ltar snang rang 'dod dregs pa'i blos// snag shog dal med bstan bcos rnams// 'bri mkhan sug pa ngal ba las// 'bras bu 'byung ba kye ma mtshar// sa steng skye bo 'khrul pa'i blo// blun po'i rdzun rib la dga' yi// mkhas pas rgyal ba'i dgongs pa dag

/dpyad gsum dag pas legs bkral bar// skyo sngogs bskyar 'byin byas so lo// de la mkhas pa'i legs bshad las// mgrin snyan don med 'bras bu che| |'on kyang rgyal ba'i bstan pa dang*// 'gro gang thar pa 'dod pa la// tshul dang mthun pa'i legs bshad 'di// dbul po'i lag tu nor bu bzhin// gang thob don chen 'bras bu 'byung*| |'di dge ston ka'i zla gzhon ltar// dri med dkar ba gang mchis pas// pha mar gyur pa'i 'gro ba rnams// 'khor ba'i rgyu 'bras kun zad cing*// dam chos nyi gzhon 'od ris kyis| |blo gros pad tshal rab rgyas te// rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa'i// rdo rje 'chang dbang myur thob shog /de ltar ring bsrel lnga'i gzhug tshul lag len tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho zhes bya ba 'di'ang rang re'i chos sras kyi thu bo yang ri'i bla ma tshul khrims rin chen gyi gsung gis bskul ba dang*/ rten gyi gzungs gzhug dang bzhengs tshul sogs kyang chos brgyad lo 'dod kyi grags snyan kho na'i ched las/ tshad ldan gyi gzhung nyams su len pa ni nyin skar las kyang ches dkon pa dag mthong nas blo ldan zur gnas rnams la phan pa'i bsam pa nye bar bzhag nas/ dbur stod 'bri gung du son pa skyu ra'i gdung las/ dus mtha'i rdo rje 'dzin pa chos kyi grags pas/ 'dzin byed kyi lo sa gas nya ba'i dkar po'i rdzogs pa gsum pa bdag cag gi ston pa mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i dus ston dang*/ 'ga' zhig gi lugs kyi ston pa lhums su zhugs pa dang*/ 'ga' zhig gis sku bltams pa dang*/ 'ga' zhig gis mya ngan las 'das pa'i dus yang bzhed pa ste/ dge mtshan du ma dang ldan pa'i dus dge bar dpal 'bri gung gi pho brang bkra shis tshugs su sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni mchog gsum lhun gyis grub pas bgyis pa ste/ 'dis kyang rgyal ba'i bstan pa yun ring du gnas pa dang sems can thams cad sgrib pa gnyis las grol nas rdzogs pa'i byang chub dam pa thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig/

//sid+dhirastu/ slar yang 'di nyid rtsom pa po gyi na ba rgan po chos kyi grags pa bdag rang gis tshig don sngags rnams la zhus tig legs po bgyis pa'i khul byas yod pas blun po rnams kyi blo dang ma mthun yang bcos slad mi mdzad pa rang sor 'jog par zhu lags/ maṅga laṃ shrī dz+wa la dzam+bu dwīpa a laṅkār gats+tshan+tu/// / ༈ /'dod gsol ni/ thub bstan snying po 'bri gung pa'i chos srid kyi bstan pa phyogs dus kun tu dar rgyas yun ring gnas pa dang bdud bgegs dgra sde'i 'tshe ba bral ba dang*/ bdag cag gi tshe dang bsod nams rtogs pa'i yon tan 'phel zhing 'brel thogs kyis gtsos 'gro kun ngan 'gro las thar te rnam mkhyen myur du thob pa dang yul khams bde skyid bkra shis dpal 'bar dge bcu 'phel bar gyur cig/ //maṅga laṃ//
